subject: Avatar object spawn/destroy runtime obligations
supersedes: docs/avatar-runtime.md five-state page is the state semantics; this is the spawn/destroy obligation contract it does not enumerate

spawn.creator_authority: framework-only; the coordinator publishes the hosting generation and a host may spawn only a route it holds at the current generation
spawn.persistence: spawn itself does not persist; a record is loaded (MLD1 LOAD / home domain) and a spawn is visible only after avatar_load succeeds
spawn.aoi_edge: spawn->active broadcasts appearance to scene observers; destroy broadcasts leave
spawn.failure_path: load failed -> closed, no visible avatar, no tombstone (nothing was published); the generation stays non-writable
spawn.refusal: a spawn without a route at the current generation, or a duplicate spawn for the same (realm, character, generation) with an existing active/loading avatar, is refused with AVATAR_ALREADY_ATTACHED

obligations_in_order.name: flush
obligations_in_order.detail: final avatar_save (single entry) acknowledged durable (ACK durable / MLD1 commit + FENCE)

obligations_in_order.name: leave_broadcast
obligations_in_order.detail: AOI leave broadcast to scene observers

obligations_in_order.name: ref_release
obligations_in_order.detail: release the scene-instance reference; the spatial cache decides eviction (two-phase, no resurrection)

obligations_in_order.name: recycle_bin
obligations_in_order.detail: the object stays addressable but inert until obligations complete; it is not freed mid-reclaim

obligations_in_order.name: tombstone
obligations_in_order.detail: fence the hosting generation; only a strictly newer generation may resume (cross-return single-writer rule)

destroy.source_of_order: scene-lifecycle cleanup order (stop entry, stop timers, evacuate, free state, release reference) + cross-return writer-lease handoff FENCE
destroy.in_flight_handlers: already-executing handlers finish; handlers arriving during transferring/loading/suspended/reclaiming are refused with the state rejection code

must: run the full destroy obligation list
tombstone the generation only after the final save is durable

four_paths.name: failure_rollback
steps: closed, no visible avatar, no tombstone
generation stays non-writable, surfaced to operator

four_paths.name: reclaim_interrupt_recovery
steps: generation stays recoverable (before tombstone, abort returns to active)
after tombstone only a newer generation resumes

failure_compensation.compensation: retry within the configured budget; no tombstone; generation stays recoverable; surface the condition to the operator/application
obligations continue (as suspended); never tombstone an unacknowledged change (cross-return: only ACK durable justifies a durability claim)
crash guarantees nothing (avatar-runtime); coordinator recovery issues a strictly newer generation
two-phase ref release prevents resurrection; re-enter reclaim; the tombstone is not committed until the flush is durable
